ITN efficacy parameterisations from experimental hut trials

Source: R/data_doc.R
ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025.Rd

Efficacy estimates and per-component insecticide half-lives for pyrethroid-only and next-generation ITNs, fitted to experimental hut trial (EHT) data from multiple sites (Champagne et al. 2025).

Efficacy components are provided for the standard three-host model (Repellent, Preprandialkilling, Postprandialkilling) and the dummy-host model (KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative).

Use get_ITN_params to load a specific net type / EHT combination into a format ready for build_intervention.

Usage

ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025

Format

A data frame with columns:

  • netType: ITN product name (e.g. "Interceptor G2", "Pyrethroid-only").

  • EHT: experimental hut trial site identifier.

  • reference: citation for the underlying EHT data.

  • parameter: efficacy component (Repellent, Preprandialkilling, Postprandialkilling, KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative, alpha_0, mu_0). KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative is relative to the control-arm availability alpha_0 (rows with netType == "control"); get_ITN_params rescales it to the absolute value used by the model, KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute. (Named KillingDuringHostSeeking in the source table.)

  • Unwashed: fitted efficacy for a new (unwashed) net.

  • Washed: fitted efficacy after washing / ageing.

  • aged_time: years represented by the washed arm (3, or 2 for Sovegnon).

  • halflife_insecticide: per-component linear insecticide decay (years), computed as aged_time / (1 - Washed / Unwashed). Despite the name, it is the time at which the effect reaches zero under linear decay, calibrated so that efficacy after aged_time years equals Washed. Negative values indicate the component efficacy increased with washing; they are kept as fitted (the effect then increases linearly over time).

  • fit: fit of the trial the row belongs to (1, or 1 and 2 when a trial was fitted in several parts, each with its own control, e.g. Sovegnon); host-seeking killing is rescaled by the control alpha_0 of the same fit.

Value

ITN efficacy parameters from experimental hut trials.

References

Champagne et al. (2025) — in preparation.

Author

Clara Champagne, clara.champagne@swisstph.ch

Examples

head(ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025)
#>           netType     EHT      reference           parameter aged_time Unwashed
#> 1 Pyrethroid-only Kibondo Kibondo et al. Postprandialkilling         3     0.21
#> 2  Interceptor G2 Kibondo Kibondo et al. Postprandialkilling         3     0.52
#> 3 Pyrethroid-only Kibondo Kibondo et al.  Preprandialkilling         3     0.26
#> 4  Interceptor G2 Kibondo Kibondo et al.  Preprandialkilling         3     0.44
#> 5 Pyrethroid-only Kibondo Kibondo et al.           Repellent         3     0.82
#> 6  Interceptor G2 Kibondo Kibondo et al.           Repellent         3     0.71
#>   Washed halflife_insecticide fit
#> 1   0.18                 21.0   1
#> 2   0.47                 31.2   1
#> 3   0.25                 78.0   1
#> 4   0.42                 66.0   1
#> 5   0.77                 49.2   1
#> 6   0.74                -71.0   1
list_ITN_params()
